note: Header navigation bar -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency selector, 'Sign in'/'Register' links, and fixed service tabs (Accommodations/Flights/Packages/Cars/Attractions/Airport taxis)
Hero banner -- renders: operator-authored marketing headline and sub-headline
Search box widget -- renders: fixed labels (Where to?, Check-in, Check-out, Guests), search button, and fixed filter checkboxes (e.g. 'I'm flexible')
Unique selling points -- renders: operator-authored value proposition headings and descriptions
Secondary promotional banner -- renders: operator-authored marketing copy and call-to-action
Property types carousel -- renders: fixed category names (Hotels, Apartments, etc.) defined by the platform
Destination postcards -- renders: fixed geographic names (cities/countries) curated by the platform
Trip types carousel -- renders: fixed trip category names (Beach, City, etc.) defined by the platform
Domestic destinations carousel -- renders: fixed geographic names curated by the platform
Genius sign-in banner -- renders: operator-authored loyalty program marketing copy
SEO interlinking -- renders: fixed category and destination names defined by the platform
Footer -- renders: fixed navigation links, legal text, and language/currency controls
Cookie consent banner -- renders: operator-authored privacy policy text and consent buttons
